title: 420Hz API/event/interface contracts

implementationBoundary.rule: HZ-GCA-1.16 freezes logical contracts and dependency bindings only; no 420Hz service ID, endpoint, contract address, deployed adapter or live wiring is invented.

rules: requestId identifies one transport/application attempt and is not reusable as business idempotency authority by itself
idempotencyKey is operation/domain/resource scoped and must bind the material request payload
actorRef is required for authority-bearing mutations and is presentation of the qualified Wallet/session actor; it cannot be caller-selected authorization without the matching Wallet/session proof
chainId/networkId are required for chain-sensitive operations and wrong-network requests fail closed
expectedRevision/sourceCheckpoint are required where lost-update/stale-state protection is material
payload must contain only the minimum fields needed for the operation and never wallet private keys, mnemonics, raw Identity proof payloads, provider secrets or unrelated private project data
eligible PUBLIC read queries may omit actorRef/idempotencyKey and remain anonymous under HZ-GCA-1.10; anonymous reads never gain mutation authority
response status does not create authority beyond the source domain
security-sensitive reads retain source identity/version and freshness/finality/checkpoint where applicable
PENDING/PARTIAL must not be presented as final success
derived Search/Indexer/Analytics responses never replace canonical source authority
events describe facts/observations and do not themselves grant Wallet, payment, Rights, Identity, moderation, Awards or governance authority
eventId is stable for dedupe/replay and duplicate delivery cannot repeat the underlying state transition
derived/rebuildable events retain source revision/checkpoint/provenance sufficient to supersede or retract stale projections
PRIVATE/UNLISTED/SECURITY_RESTRICTED events are excluded from public Search/Analytics feeds unless a later explicit privacy-safe aggregate policy allows it
event payloads are minimum-disclosure and may carry commitments/references instead of private bytes

logicalInterfaces.name: RegistryDiscovery420Hz
forbidden: treat cached deprecated service as active
grant app authority from registration alone

logicalInterfaces.name: WalletAuthorization420Hz
forbidden: treat wallet connection alone as approval

logicalInterfaces.name: AIGeneration420Hz
forbidden: accept provider prose as canonical success

logicalInterfaces.name: ComputeExecution420Hz
forbidden: treat observation as authority beyond ComputeMarket

logicalInterfaces.name: CreativeRights420Hz
forbidden: rehash native IDs into competing canonical IDs

logicalInterfaces.name: IdentityEligibility420Hz
consumes: profile/credential reference or privacy-preserving proof reference
forbidden: return raw legal identity by default

logicalInterfaces.name: IndexerSearchRead420Hz
forbidden: hide stale/degraded context on security-sensitive reads

logicalInterfaces.name: Notifications420Hz
forbidden: treat delivery success/failure as source authorization

logicalInterfaces.name: Analytics420Hz
consumes: public or privacy-safe aggregate event/snapshot references

eventCatalogue.authority: 420Hz workflow fact; AI/Compute refs remain authoritative
failure state reference; no refund implied
Awards vote acceptance; public voter identity not implied
bounded external ruling observation; no automatic remedy
delivery failure only; source operation unchanged

eventRules: generation success does not imply REGISTERED or PUBLISHED
generation cancel/fail does not imply payer refund paid
release events reference canonical Creative IDs rather than duplicating publication authority
community events do not become Chart credit unless admitted by the exact chart policy
ChartSnapshot publication does not create Award eligibility/result
AwardVote events do not become Chart or Civic votes
moderation report events are allegations and do not imply enforcement
Arbitration ruling observation never auto-executes a remedy
notification delivery events never change source state
idempotencyReplayRules: each mutating command has an operation/domain/resource scoped idempotency key bound to material payload
retry of the same command returns/reconciles the existing logical result or fails without duplicate state
changed payload under the same idempotency key fails as conflict/replay
event redelivery uses stable eventId and cannot reapply the source mutation
cross-chain/cross-domain reuse of authorization, idempotency key, voter nullifier, settlement reference or moderation capability fails closed
versioningCompatibilityRules: schemaVersion is explicit on every request/response/event envelope
dependency service identity/version is discovered/validated against canonical Registry or another repository-approved source where required
breaking field/semantic changes require a new interface/schema version rather than silent reinterpretation
unknown required enum/state values fail closed; additive optional fields may be ignored only when the consumer explicitly supports forward compatibility
accepted jobs/ballots/results retain the interface/policy commitments frozen at acceptance even if a newer service/interface version becomes active
privacyMinimumDisclosureRules: private generation payloads travel by protected references/bytes only to interfaces that need them; Search/Analytics/Notifications never receive raw private prompts/drafts
Identity voting integration consumes only the minimum-disclosure predicate/nullifier result
moderation/Arbitration public events carry commitments/status, not raw private evidence
Notification payloads omit secrets, private Identity proofs, raw payment details and unrelated project state
Analytics receives only public/privacy-safe aggregate signals
public API/query responses never broaden the source object's visibility
failureRules: missing actor/domain/idempotency context for a mutating command fails closed
wrong chain/network or inactive/deprecated incompatible service fails closed
stale revision/checkpoint on a protected mutation/read fails closed or requires explicit refresh
dependency timeout/unavailability cannot be converted into synthetic success
unknown breaking schema/state cannot be guessed
private/unlisted payload cannot fall back to a public event/query path
duplicate command/event delivery cannot repeat payment, generation, community, chart, nomination, vote, moderation or publication side effects
derived read disagreement with canonical source cannot authorize a privileged transition
Notification/Analytics/Search delivery or indexing failure cannot roll back or rewrite source state
Arbitration observation cannot invoke a remedy outside the HZ-GCA-1.14 allowlist
invariants: HZGCA-API-001 HZ-GCA-1.16 defines logical interfaces only and assigns no 420Hz canonical service ID, endpoint, address or live adapter
HZGCA-API-002 every mutating command binds qualified actor, domain, resource and idempotency context
HZGCA-API-003 Wallet/session authority is external and private signing material never enters 420Hz API payloads
HZGCA-API-004 dependency identity/version/freshness is validated before security-sensitive use
HZGCA-API-005 request replay or changed-payload idempotency reuse cannot duplicate or mutate an existing logical operation
HZGCA-API-006 event redelivery is deduplicated and events never become ambient cross-domain authority
HZGCA-API-007 private/unlisted/security-restricted payloads never enter public Search/Analytics/event surfaces by fallback
HZGCA-API-008 420AI/Compute result observation cannot bypass canonical verification/settlement rules
HZGCA-API-009 Creative/Rights native IDs and authority are referenced, never redefined by 420Hz
HZGCA-API-010 Storage references do not imply universal deletion authority and integrity mismatch fails closed
HZGCA-API-011 Identity integration is minimum-disclosure and never substitutes for Wallet authorization
HZGCA-API-012 Search/Indexer/Analytics responses are derived and never authoritative for protected state transitions
HZGCA-API-013 Notifications delivery state cannot mutate source application/protocol state
HZGCA-API-014 Community events do not automatically become Chart or Award signals
HZGCA-API-015 AwardVote remains distinct from Chart, Community and Civic/Governance events
HZGCA-API-016 moderation and Arbitration interfaces preserve HZ-GCA-1.14 scoped/allowlisted remedy boundaries
HZGCA-API-017 breaking interface semantics require explicit version change and frozen accepted operations retain their bound version/policy
HZGCA-API-018 API/event contracts create no new custody, Rights, Identity, payment, governance, resolver or protocol authority
exitCriteria: privacy/minimum-disclosure and derived-state boundaries are explicit
targeted verifier checks canonical dependency IDs against repository ServiceIds420 where applicable
no 420Hz service ID, endpoint, address, ABI, deployed adapter or testnet/live state is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.17 through HZ-GCA-1.20
